facts.text: OT2Env is a Gymnasium environment wrapper for the OT-2 pipetting robot digital twin
The observation is [pipette_x, pipette_y, pipette_z, goal_x, goal_y, goal_z]
The action is [vx, vy, vz] continuous velocities in [-1, 1]
The reward is the negative Euclidean distance to the goal with a +10 bonus on success
The action space is Box(low=[-1, -1, -1], high=[1, 1, 1])
The observation space is Box(shape=(6,)) with unbounded low and high
A reset seeds numpy when a seed is given, resets the simulation and draws the goal uniformly between _LOW and _HIGH
A step runs the simulation with the action plus a drop flag of 0 and re-reads the pipette position
A distance below 0.01 terminates the episode and adds 10 to the reward
The episode truncates when the step counter reaches max_steps
The info dictionary reports current_position, target_position and distance_to_goal
The OT-2 digital twin runs in PyBullet
The twin connects PyBullet in GUI mode when render is true and in DIRECT mode otherwise
The twin loads the simulated robot from ot_2_simulation_v6.urdf
The pipette position is the robot base position minus the joint positions plus the pipette offset

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the goal draw and the fake's position update is deterministic, so one seed and one action sequence repeat a trajectory; upstream seeds numpy's global generator and runs PyBullet on its own clock, so a seed does not repeat a trajectory across the two

gaps: the fake is kinematic: one direct position update per transition, not PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, forces or the simulation clock; no actuator, sensor or noise model
no simulated time base: timestep_ms is 0 and a step is one discrete transition, not a physical duration
the PyBullet GUI/DIRECT renderer is not modelled: render() is a no-op

the upstream environment was not run (gymnasium and pybullet are not installed where the gate ran), so the fake was never compared with it; the goal draw uses random.Random, upstream numpy's global generator
observations are Python lists of floats, upstream returns float32 numpy arrays and rounds the pipette position to four decimals
reset accepts only seed, like the upstream signature; cap.world.reset.v1 options are not supported and the bridge falls back to a seedless reset when options are supplied
no droplet, specimen or plate physics is modelled
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
